commands:
gh pr diff 1256 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1256/run/diff.patch
echo "files in cache:"; grep -c '^diff --git' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1256/run/diff.patch
echo "total lines:"; wc -l < .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1256/run/diff.patch
echo "added (non +++):"; grep -cE '^\+[^+]' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1256/run/diff.patch
echo "removed (non ---):"; grep -cE '^-[^-]' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1256/run/diff.patch

for f in "skills/review/SKILL.md" "skills/review/phases/phase-0-3-6-blocker-recheck.md"; do
echo "===== $f ====="
awk -v tgt="$f" '$0=="diff --git a/"tgt" b/"tgt{f=1;print;next} /^diff --git/{f=0} f' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1256/run/diff.patch
done

echo "=== forbidden spelling in ADDED diff lines within skills/agents (excluding fixtures/tests) ==="
awk '/^diff --git/{p=$0} /^\+/{print p"\t"$0}' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1256/run/diff.patch \
 | grep -E 'skills/|agents/' | grep -vE 'fixtures/|lint-ungranted' \
 | grep -oE '(^|[^/.-])scripts/(post-review-verdict|dismiss-stale-rejections)\.sh' \
 || echo "(none added — clean)"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
